June cache

This ancient storehouse is the only trace of the Junes on Jigran. Powerful magic created and sealed it to keep their knowledge and artefacts from falling into the wrong hands.

The freed Joons and Kir’s family

Kel and Rad discover that Firez is moving the Joon prisoners from the mountain prison into his fortress. Kel plans an attack on the transfer, avoiding a direct prison assault. Among those freed are Tai-Ilara, whom Kir admired as a child, and the elder Tui-Len. Tai-Ilara welcomes his changed appearance and asks him to retrieve belongings left behind. Tui-Len brings harder news: Kir’s parents are dead. The elder fears that killing Firez will expose the survivors to the Curse, but Kir tells him that Tka-Rik and At-Zako have already destroyed it. Tui-Len also opens the sealed Joon cache whose amulet Kir has recovered. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]

The Joon cache and allies for the assault

The sealed cache supplies Kir with Joon armour, but Tui-Len warns him against relying on hatred alone. He gives him an amulet that can turn dangerous creatures into allies. Rad identifies suitable hunting grounds for a cyclops and a dragon. Their recruitment changes the military balance and answers the baron’s objection that his soldiers cannot face Firez’s necromancy in a direct assault. Virril finally orders the attack. Before the confrontation, Rad speaks of the quiet home and family he hopes to have when his secret work is finished. The cache is found in the valley Rad hopes to settle after the war. Dartas’s account of a nearby village destroyed by harpies points Kir to the rectangular amulet needed at its sealed entrance; Tui-Len supplies the remaining magical help. During the assault, Firez sends the city’s population, transformed into undead, against the Canian force. Kir must break through this army to reach the palace. [7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 5, 3, 12]
